fact: The Ministry of Planning reports that on 18 December 2025 the government launched the cash-transfer component of the Programme National de Protection Sociale, for more than 700,000 people targeted by INSEED and ANADEB, to be paid at 25,000 FCFA per household through mobile money (Mixx by Yas and Flooz).
system: Programme National de Protection Sociale, cash-transfer component

fact: The World Bank's ISR for the ASTRE programme (P178835) records that as at 30 September 2024 the eID was soft-launched on 27 November 2023, the RSPM social registry software was 75% complete, and the data exchange platform between eID, RSPM, BOMS and other administrative systems was 'Not in place', with a target of December 2026.
system: Interoperable social information system (SIIS) and data exchange platform

fact: Arrêté n° 007/24/MENTD/CAB of 10 September 2024 sets the conditions under which public bodies may access and share data of the Registre social des personnes et des ménages: ANID supplies the data through personalised accounts on the RSPM platform after a request, a signed ANID convention and, for personal data, IPDCP authorisation; it names no body that has been connected.
system: Registre social des personnes et des ménages (RSPM)

fact: The World Bank and Government of Togo case study says NOVISSI's system automatically sent payroll files through an API to the two mobile network operators (Togocom and Moov Africa Togo), whose mobile money systems were made interoperable with it, and paid over 920,000 people by August 2021.

The case study says Togo is building, under a US$72 million IDA-financed WURI programme, a foundational unique identification platform for all residents, to be the basis of a dynamic social registry of individuals and households, both listed as priorities of the 2020-2025 government roadmap.
system: Foundational unique ID platform (WURI) and planned dynamic social registry

fact: The case study says that during NOVISSI's operation (2020-2021) Togo had no dynamic social registry and no unique identifier covering all residents, so some households may have received multiple transfers because the assistance unit was the individual.

Decree 2023-043/PR of 24 April 2023 creates the RSPM and obliges administrations to base their aid programmes on it and its household scores (art. 14), as a legal duty with no statement that any programme yet draws on it.
system: Registre social des personnes et des ménages (RSPM)

fact: Togo's presentation says the RSPM was being integrated in 2025 to link socio-economic data across institutions through the e-ID, over the RSIA.
